keep.title: Again sometime?

connections.empty: Nothing coming up yet — browse the plans.

create.title: Where are you going this week anyway?
create.textSafetyHint: No exact address or time in the text: write “Coffee on Sunday”, not “10am, Café Freud”. Share the spot later, directly with everyone who's in.
create.fixHint: The date is set — who's coming along?
create.fixTimeHint: Only the day is public. You'll settle the exact time in chat once someone's in.
create.flexHint: People tap the days that work for them — you set the date afterwards. Window max. 7 days.
create.alreadyFlexible: You already have a flexible plan. Delete it first or set its date.
create.alcoholFreeHint: Appears as a small badge on your plan.
create.verifiedOnlyHint: Few profiles are verified so far — this narrows things down a lot.
create.visibilityHint: If someone doesn't fit, they never see your plan. Filtering happens before — not through rejection after.
create.publishError: That didn't work — please try again.
create.needDateTime: Pick a date and time of day.

setupError.title: Database not set up yet

location.noResults: Nothing found — try the place name.

onboarding.saveError: Saving didn't work — please try again. If it happens again, let me know.

basics.title: Glad you're here.
basics.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself.

photosStep.title: Show yourself.
photosStep.subtitle: 3 to 5 photos — 2 are enough to start. Important: the first photo shows your face.

aboutStep.title: About you.
aboutStep.subtitle: A sentence or two is plenty — how you are, not your CV.
aboutStep.placeholder: e.g. Half gym, half croissants. Always up for plans worth telling stories about.

promptsStep.title: Two questions, honest answers.
promptsStep.subtitle: Pick two questions and answer in your own words. A third one is optional.

locationStep.title: Where's home?
locationStep.subtitle: Just a neighbourhood, town or postcode — never your address.
locationStep.privacyHint: Others only ever see this label — never an address or exact distance.

interestsStep.title: What do you already love doing?

firstPlan.title: Create your first plan.
firstPlan.subtitle: Where are you going this week anyway? Invite someone along.
firstPlan.laterHint: No pressure — you can create a plan any time.

intent.intentHint: Only sorts what you see first — nobody is excluded. And you can always create any kind of plan.
intent.categoriesHint: Categories only sort your feed — nobody is ever excluded.
intent.orientHint: Only steers your Discover set — visible to no one.
intent.relHint: What's true for you. Only shown if you set it.

me.currentHint: Used instead of your home while it's set. Remove it to switch back.
me.radiusHint: Shows you plans within this radius — you can widen it any time. Others only see your place, never your address or exact distance.
